title: Task Complexity Decomposition: Can Oversight Quality Be Maintained by Reducing Task Complexity?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Task decomposition as a scalable oversight technique has a clear impact chain: if complex tasks can be decomposed to maintain oversight quality, this is a general-purpose tool. Quantifying the complexity budget provides actionable guidance.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Decomposing a task into subtasks of varying complexity and measuring overseer accuracy on each is conceptually accessible. The main challenge is finding a good task with natural decomposition levels. Feasible with API-based models as overseers.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One task, decomposed into subtasks, one overseer, one accuracy measurement per complexity level. The deliverable (maximum complexity at which oversight maintains accuracy) is well-defined. Achievable in 30 hours.
